name: s1-sharp-thorn-life-reduced
about: S1 Standard Magic (v0.88.0), condition lifeReduced: Sharp Thorn (26RBS03-097) destroys an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit, or a Cost 7 or less one when your Life was reduced this turn. The opponent controls only a Cost 5 Spirit, so the Magic is usable only after a Life core left the player's Life this turn.
